FISHING TRIPS · UNITED STATES

Non-resident fishing license cost by state

For a fishing trip to another state, the licence costs from $11 (South Carolina) to $81 (Oklahoma) for a 3-day weekend, and from $11 (South Carolina) to $138 (Oregon) for a week. The median price is $32 for 3 days and $55 for 7 days. Each price is from the state agency.

  • Weekend trip, 3 days$11 to $81Median $32
  • Week trip, 7 days$11 to $138Median $55
  • Full year$20 to $174.14Median $63, 48 states with a listed price

How to read the table

  • Each price is for an adult who does not live in the state.
  • The trip price is the lowest-priced licence that covers all days of the trip. The name of that licence is below the price.
  • Where the state requires a stamp or fee with that licence, the price includes it and the row names it.
  • Stamps for one species or one water, such as trout, salmon or saltwater, are not in the price. The state page lists them.
  • Most rows show the freshwater licence. Where a state sells the coastal licence as the main visitor product, the licence name shows it.
  • Each row links to the state page, which has all visitor options, the rules and the official link to buy.

Holiday and end-of-year trips

  • In 5 states the annual licence in this table ends on 31 December: Alaska, Connecticut, Massachusetts, New Jersey, Oregon. For a Thanksgiving, Christmas or New Year trip there, compare the short licence first. A trip that crosses 1 January can need a licence for each year.
  • In 18 states the annual licence is valid for 12 months from the date you buy it: Arizona, California, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Kansas, Louisiana, Maryland, Mississippi, Nevada, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, Tennessee, Utah, Wyoming. A licence for a holiday trip also covers a trip next summer.
  • Free fishing days in November and December, from the state agencies:
    • Florida: Freshwater: first Saturday and Sunday in April, second Saturday and Sunday in June. Saltwater: first Saturday and Sunday in June, first Saturday in September, Saturday after Thanksgiving. Source
    • New York: February 14-15, June 27-28, September 26 and November 11, 2026 Source
    • North Dakota: June 6-7, 2026 and December 26-27, 2026 Residents only. Source
    • Oregon: February 14-15, June 6-7 and November 27-28, 2026 Source
  • See free fishing days by state for every date, rule and visitor answer.
  • The other states use a licence year with a fixed end date. The full-year column shows that period for each state.
  • Buy the licence online before you travel. State offices and many licence agents close on public holidays.
  • Seasons and closures change by water and by month. See the season notes and the trips for each state.

Questions

How much is a fishing license for an out-of-state trip?

For a 3-day trip the licence costs from $11 (South Carolina) to $81 (Oklahoma), with a median of $32. For a 7-day trip it costs from $11 to $138, with a median of $55.

Which states have the cheapest non-resident fishing license for a week?

The five lowest prices for a 7-day trip in this table are: South Carolina ($11), Maryland ($12), Delaware ($12.50), North Carolina ($15), New Jersey ($19.50).

Which state has the most expensive non-resident annual fishing license?

California has the highest full-year price in this table: $174.14. Delaware has the lowest: $20.

Do I need a licence for each state I fish in?

Yes. Each state sells its own licence. A licence from one state is not valid in another state, except on some shared border waters. The state page shows the rule for each place.
